r.경제 체제: Market economy · pharmaceuticals, precision machinery, watches, finance and wealth management
r.주식시장 시가총액: $2.5 trillion, 241% of GDP (2025, listed domestic companies)

t.why: A long-neutral country; Geneva hosts many international organizations and often serves as a venue for peace talks.
t.rel: A long-neutral country that has not joined the EU but is bound to it by many agreements. Geneva hosts many UN and international bodies and often serves as a venue for mediated talks.
t.korea: Since the Korean armistice it has kept a delegation of the Neutral Nations Supervisory Commission at Panmunjom.
t.know: Switzerland has enough nuclear shelters for almost its entire population.
t.etext: It makes and sells high-value products such as pharmaceuticals, precision machinery, watches and chocolate. It is a world center for gold trading, banking and wealth management. The Swiss franc is a safe-haven currency that money floods into during crises.
